info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Cross-Channel Servicing Activity Analysis API
info.description: The Cross-Channel Servicing Activity Analysis API allows businesses to submit and analyze servicing activity data across various channels. It facilitates insights into customer interactions and service efficiency, enabling organizations to optimize their servicing strategies. This API is particularly useful for financial institutions looking to improve customer experience through data-driven decisions. Typical users include data analysts, customer service managers, and IT professionals who need to streamline servicing activities and enhance operational performance.

post.summary: Create a new servicing activity analysis.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to generate a new analysis for servicing activities across channels. It enables businesses to evaluate performance, identify trends, and improve servicing strategies.
